name: with nothing armed the new plan records NO marker instead of starting a line
expect: ...and arming with NOTHING armed records `-` (a started line)

name: the armed plan is never taken as the parent
expect: ⭐ arming while another plan is armed records the armed plan as the parent

name: a turn boundary never clears a fully-ticked plan
expect: ⭐ a fully-ticked plan is CLEARED at the turn boundary, so the next arm is `-`

name: the boundary clears a PAUSED plan too
expect: ⭐ a PAUSED plan survives the boundary and stays the parent

name: every arm re-derives the parent, so a re-arm rewrites lineage
expect: ⭐ re-arming an existing plan KEEPS its first parent

name: a refusal is read as unreadable output, so a failed call poisons the state

name: a hand edit of the sentinel goes unseen

name: a bare state line is taken by the FIRST call that could print one
expect: ⭐ `--finish && begin-plan next | tail`: the bare state line is the ARM's, and the finish it got past cleared the sentinel

name: a --finish cut by tail is never inferred to have run
expect: ⭐ `--finish && begin-plan next | tail`: the bare state line is the ARM's, and the finish it got past cleared the sentinel

for b in banners if b in plans):

name: a plan that already has a marker is reconstructed over
expect: ⛔ a plan that ALREADY has a marker is untouched, whatever the replay says

name: a file born before its first recorded arm is still linked
expect: ⛔ a file BORN before its first recorded arm: that arm was a re-arm, so no marker

expect: ⛔ the DRY RUN writes nothing
